items.title: Fractured Archive: November changes and OSRS loot
items.summary: The raid follows the 11 November OSRS update, with solo and duo kept as they were. Loot matches OSRS: the unique is 1 in 14 solo or duo and better with more players, down to 1 in 7.5 for eight, and dying costs part of your own share instead of making it harder for the team. During the beta a team wipe still keeps your items.

items.title: Fractured Archive fixes from the first runs
items.summary: The party display survives the fades and its timer counts the whole raid. Bork walks round the Smorks, the Guardian is solid on the ground, Xarth's pillars all come down, and Ocellus no longer sticks to his tank. The vault's chests and braziers are there as you walk in, and your own chest sparkles.

items.title: Client: 117 HD update and a Drop Viewer
items.summary: 117 HD is updated, with new textures and lighting for the Fractured Archive and a fix for Ocellus's floor vanishing. The casket button in the sidebar opens a Drop Viewer for any monster or item. Five hub plugins that send your account data to outside sites are hidden. Your launcher downloads the new client once.

items.title: About a hundred small things matched to OSRS
items.summary: We fixed about a hundred messages, animations and effects on bosses and skills that didn't match OSRS. The Abyssal Sire, Araxxor, Jad, Corp and many more fight as they look in OSRS, skilling messages read the same, and a Barrows chest with no kills always gives its loot now.

items.title: The Fractured Archive
items.summary: The new raid is in. Start a party at the lobby, pick your path and work through the rooms. All eight bosses fight the way they do in the real raid, with the vault, the records room and its capes, the Quartermaster's shop, and the rewards: the Obligator, the Rondache, ascension bolts, Zeal and the pets.

items.title: Weapon specials and passives match OSRS
items.summary: Every weapon special, passive and set effect was checked against OSRS and corrected. Melee passives were redone, so the salve amulet replaces the slayer helmet bonus instead of stacking. Magic damage is additive, the twisted bow scales the right way, and monsters defend against light, standard and heavy ranged separately like OSRS.

items.title: The game and client are up to date
items.summary: We brought the game and client up to date with OSRS again at the end of October. RuneLite's plugins recognise our monsters, items and clues properly now, so the slayer counter, the clue helper and the loot tracker all work, and the newest gear sits where the wiki says it does. Your launcher re-downloads the game files once.

items.title: Hunter: falconry, butterflies and Varlamore
items.summary: Falconry and butterfly netting are built. Jerboas, pyre foxes, sunlight and moonlight moths and moonlight antelopes are catchable, maniacal monkeys can be trapped in Glough's Laboratory, and five kebbits can be tracked. A pile of trap bugs went with it: traps laid from a stack are no longer lost, and deadfalls asked for a level eight too high.

items.title: Four agility courses and the Brimhaven arena
items.summary: Shayzien, Colossal Wyrm, Werewolf and Ape Atoll are built, each with teleports. The Brimhaven Agility Arena is in with its traps, pit falls, plank rotation, monkey bars and darts.

items.title: Slayer monsters, tasks and a task portal
items.summary: Seven more Slayer monsters are in with their caves, drops and tasks. Killerwatt, molanisk, terror dog, brine rat and elf tasks are assignable again, and Konar names Vampyre and Warped creature tasks. A portal at home teleports you to your task for 100,000 coins, free for Extreme Donators and up.

items.title: Skilling checked against the wiki
items.summary: Experience formulas, cooking burn levels, gathering success, combination runes and the Ourania altar all match OSRS now. Gathering stays twice as generous as OSRS, but the formulas underneath are the real ones. Birdhouses are fixed: a part-filled one used to eat your seeds.

items.title: Crucible values, death values and the Upgrade Table
items.summary: Death values were rebuilt on real OSRS prices. Crucible values were redone by boss tier, so GWD and the Dagannoth Kings came down and Corporeal Beast's sigils went up. Upgrade Table items hold what went into them, dismantling asks first and tells you the cost, and every attempt is recorded, so if it looks like the table ate something we can check.

items.title: Ironman and group ironman
items.summary: Hardcore Iron Men keep their items when they die outside the Wilderness and only lose the status, like OSRS. A Group Iron Man can loot a group member, a portal at home takes you back to The Node, and leaving a group now gives you the real choice between staying ranked, going unranked or becoming a regular player.

items.title: Three temporary scrolls
items.summary: Droprate, Harmful (+10% damage against monsters for 30 minutes) and Double drops (a 25% chance per kill to get the kill loot again, 30 minutes). They stack, and each one shows its countdown in My Boosts.

items.title: New gear and a world boss
items.summary: King's barrage and the Hallowfell are in with their projectiles and passives, the Antler guard is equippable and in the Vote Store, and a Gemstone Crab world boss was added with its teleport row. Seeking arrows are tradeable in every tier with proper stack models.

items.title: Collection log, music and the skill guide
items.summary: Every music track unlocks and plays, Varlamore onwards included, and 104 of them start in the right places. Collection log pages draw their headers again and reopen properly, the modern skill guide is in behind its OSRS-style setting, and the bank and deposit box had a round of fixes.

items.title: Boss fixes across the board
items.summary: Hueycoatl body segments move and crumble instead of standing frozen, its braziers light and its pillars charge at the right rate. Nex switches target every third attack and lost a prayer lockout it never had, Araxxor rolls its table at the stated chances with supplies and seeds back, and wilderness bosses charge their entry fee properly instead of once ever.

items.title: 551 items had the wrong stats
items.summary: 551 equippable items had the wrong bonuses and 398 of those had none at all, which is fixed. Ornament kits were deleting the stats of the gear they painted, heavy armour was giving mages a magic bonus instead of a penalty, and 206 items that were stronger than their OSRS versions came back in line.

items.title: Monster stats, and the animations they were missing
items.summary: 2,676 monster stats moved to OSRS values: hitpoints, attack speed, max hit and bonuses. 672 monsters were missing their attack, block or death animations and have them now, and 42 were attacking with the wrong style.

items.title: Birdhouses, traps and the Warriors Guild
items.summary: Birdhouses were a mess: a part-filled one ate your seeds, a seeded one could never read full, and the timer ignored your rank. Hunter traps got a pass too, and in the Warriors Guild half the catapult buttons and the Defensive dummy never worked.

items.title: Shops, teleports and Ghommal's lucky charms
items.summary: Shops restocked and the teleports reworked. Ghommal's lucky ring is in: 10% chance to heal 10 on a kill, 1.5x boss points, 4% drop rate. Buy the penny from the Boss points Store and upgrade a ring of wealth (i) into one.

items.title: Clue scrolls point where they should
items.summary: Map clues were sending you to the wrong spot about one step in five, which is fixed. We went through every other step too and pulled the ones you could not finish, like anagrams no clue helper recognised and NPCs that were not in the game. Music steps used to ask for tracks you had no way to get, so all music is unlocked.

items.title: Town Board reworked
items.summary: There's a 20 level ladder behind the board now, with rewards on nine of them and a permanent 3% drop rate at the top. Town Points have somewhere to go too. Spend them at the Exchange on rerolls, an extra task slot, or wiping the board for a fresh set. Tasks and targets were redone as well.

items.title: Every skilling teleport is on the menu
items.summary: 41 of the 47 skilling teleports could only be reached by typing a search. They are all listed now. The dead Misc button became Recent on every spellbook, and the dungeon entrance teleports go where they say instead of claiming Edgeville.

items.title: Boss mechanics switched on
items.summary: Dagannoth Kings spawn their spinolyps, so the moat is a threat instead of scenery. Bryophyta summons her growthlings. Abyssal Sire's last form is properly tanky and swings at the right speed, the ToA Wardens are back on their real timing, and Doom's rock knocks you off your tile. Eleven bosses shared between slayer and raids were also blocking Combat Achievements for everyone, which is sorted.

items.title: Drop rate bonuses now actually help
items.summary: Every drop rate source was checked against what it claimed. The bonus is applied the right way round now, so the rarest drops on over a thousand tables are reachable again. Kills count every time something dies rather than only the first, so respawns build your rates properly. Two boss tables were also handing out uniques twice as often as they should.

items.title: Monsters fight back properly now
items.summary: 418 monsters around the world were going down in a single hit, cave horrors among them, and another 55 were attacking at the wrong speed. They now all have their real stats.

items.title: Royal Titans rebuilt
items.summary: The Royal Titans fight barely ran before and has been rebuilt: the walls, the telegraphs, the stomps, the movement and the safe tile all work now. Yama had a long accuracy pass alongside it, from the meteor to the shadow waves crossing in the middle.

items.title: Moons collection log + Lunar Chest
items.summary: Moons of Peril collection log page is in. The Lunar Chest now works like the raid chests: kill moons, open it in the Ancient Shrine, take or bank your loot.

items.title: Moons boss HP bars + kill checklist
items.summary: All three Moons show the boss health overlay, and a checklist tracks your kills per trip. Eclipse clone phase and searing rays polished. Upgrade table examine fixed.

items.title: Blood Moon & Eclipse Moon full fights
items.summary: Both moons now run their complete fights: Blood Rain, the jaguar heal race, the Moon Shield and the clone phase. Achievements system is live.

items.title: Content and fixes batch
items.summary: Bolt pouch, three elven shops, quiver ammo pickup, GE tax 2%, upgrade table rework, and a big round of combat and skilling corrections.

items.title: The Maggot King
items.summary: New boss from The Blood Moon Rises in his Vampyrium lair under Castle Drakan, with 30+ new items ported from the update.

items.title: Sol Heredit, Prestige and more
items.summary: Sol Heredit is now a real fight with a reward chest. Prestige system, redesigned teleport menu, smarter drop viewer, and dozens of fixes.

items.title: Pre-launch audit sweep
items.summary: Big cleanup round: dupe and security fixes, drop table corrections, collection log repairs, and the Inferno completion reward.

items.title: Yama gear and item fixes
items.summary: Oathplate and more endgame gear ported in, item stats corrected across the board, and a round of interface and bank fixes.

items.title: Sigils reworked, and the Crucible of Conviction
items.summary: The sigil system got a rework, with the Codex and the Crucible of Conviction alongside it. New welcome and starter task screens too.

items.title: Munity Beta is live
items.summary: Server is up and open for testing. All progress wipes before full launch.

items.title: Scurrius and Yama reworks
items.summary: Scurrius is now a proper 3-phase fight. Yama glyphs swap cleanly, Judge bug fixed. Yama takes +20% from demonbane and +50% from water spells.

items.title: Combat, specs and interfaces
items.summary: Tonalztics Division special added. Purging Staff demonbane 20% to 40% and stacks with Mark of Darkness. Blue Moon Frost Storm and Weapon Freeze reworked.

items.title: Moons of Peril and Hueycoatl
items.summary: New bosses: Blood Moon, Blue Moon, Eclipse Moon, The Hueycoatl. New gear: Blue Moon Spear, Soulflame Horn, Oathplate set, Sunlight Crossbow.
